title: Duplicate Start type-change ownership and Stop timing matrix

scope.claim: B05 is closed by deterministic active-run ownership coverage. B06 is closed by the current deterministic early/mid/near-completion matrix composed with the already-live public Stop proof from LWB-R7-130.

conflictingStart.expectedMessage: A map scan is already in progress.

assertions: The conflicting changed-type Start is rejected before reacquiring live context.
The original backend-selected scanMode, scanStrategy and concurrency remain unchanged.
Context acquisition count remains exactly one.

commonAssertions: Exactly one capture is blocked in-flight at each Stop boundary.
map_scan_stop waits for terminal engine cancellation and returns phase=idle with isReading=false.
The canceled in-flight block never becomes a durable checkpoint.
Every retained checkpoint has the recovered status value completed.
No source call or checkpoint is added after Stop returns.
Previously published City data remains present; a stopped partial run never publishes/replaces it.

liveComposition.fact: A real active Fast scan was stopped while still at 0/2500 and returned terminal idle through public map_scan_stop.

B05.rationale: Changed-type duplicate Start is rejected with the active ownership contract and cannot mutate run identity, types, strategy/config or reacquire context.

B06.rationale: Current deterministic coverage closes early/mid/near-completion cancellation/checkpoint semantics; R7-130 supplies the already-live public Stop-to-idle behavior.

remainingTechnicallyActionable: B07 deliberate bridge loss/recovery during an active scan.
B11 native point/march add-update-remove-movement transition matrix.
C04 mark/unmark -> rescan -> restart -> relocate end-to-end.
